venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Monday 7/13 (MOD: MKZ).** Net sales $381 vs a $1,166 target (−67%); 19 guests at a $20.06 check average; comps $3.00 (industry love). Food $33; no events. Rain early in the evening, clear from 7pm on. Very slow Monday that gave staff plenty of time for cleaning projects. MOD was offsite 5:45–10pm with zero alerts. A handful of industry folks from surrounding businesses (including New Realm Brewing Co.) lined the bar from 10:30 to last call for post-shift drinks. Kitchen: smooth shift, clean close. Liquor order arrives tomorrow. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Monday 7/13 (MOD: MD; Chef: JMS).** Net sales $518 vs a $1,413 target (−63%); 14 guests at a $37 check average; comps $5.80 (1.1%). Food $42; no events. Intense scattered showers — at times a deluge — kept things exceptionally slow, one of the slower nights seen here. Team got a lot of cleaning done (stainless, floor drains, lowboys). A handful of new folks from the area came in. 86: Tanqueray, Lalo. Chiller flagged for maintenance. Favorite moment: talking cocktails with first-time guests who turned out to be industry living in the Neuhoff and complimented the hospitality. No incidents; no-shows not charged.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Monday 7/13 (AM: Maggie S & Carey; PM: Maggie H).** Total net sales $9,500.44 vs a $7,390 target (+29%); 191 guests (Tock) at a $49.74 check average; comps $527.10. Splits: DC/AM $836.97, D&C PM $8,663.47; food $3,120.65; no events. Hot day. AM: solid calm business crowd with steady flow, zero IRDs; dialed in light-roast coffee (moved grind to 7.3 for a blueberry nose and tea-like mouthfeel), filtered fresh cold brew, restocked honey chai. PM: steady night with lots of industry friends in house and heavy kitchen volume; 86'd oysters early on Oyster Monday, decent IRDs, no cuts given the business. Kitchen held it down on a busy Monday with a heavy prep list for tomorrow (911s on quenelles, chicken breast, pasta dough, braised rabbit, steaks, succotash and more; 86 chips, oysters, seared scallops). No incidents; no-shows not charged. Spirits high, joy contagious in the kitchen.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Monday 7/13 (MOD: Thomas/Kyler; Chef: Alejandro).** Net sales $4,222 vs a $4,122 target (+2%); 112 covers at a $38 check average; comps $109.62. Splits: food $674, beverage $3,518, retail $40; no events. Emergent heatwave. Incredibly smooth flow with nary a flat seat and a steady drip of guests (no breaks in any 15-minute period) until 11:30pm; most tables camped, a few reached near-cocktail-nirvana. 42 oysters, 5 solos, 1 large party. Top sellers: Rosalie, Eight Limb Daiquiri, High Plains Drifter. Door: peaceful Monday, a walk-in couple celebrating an engagement at open; groups moved inside as darkness fell, full 8:30–11pm, a 5-top at 11:15 marked the last of foot traffic. Welcomed Eduardo Santillo (Gabriel Kreuther) and Koba (after performing at Red Lion). 1 tulip + 1 SOF broken. No no-shows.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Monday 7/13 (MOD: Mikey, Vic; Chef: Oscar).** Net sales $4,511 (all Marquee) vs a $4,714 target (−4%); 109 guests at a $95.98 average order; comps $378.78 (VIPs, Shochu party of 10, employee discounts, industry from Camphor, investors). Food $1,242; no events. Warm weather, no effect on service. Busy start with the bar top filling within 20 minutes and the floor soon after; lots of industry and familiar faces including the Shochu event crew from Redbird (Edwin, Saleh, Joe) and investors (the Magician, Gwenyth). Floor flow got tricky as the Shochu group grew beyond the original 10, but the team showed them a great time and they left very happy. Sold 100+ oysters. Clean, easy close. 86: cheese plate (cheese went bad); low tuna crudo. No incidents; no-shows not charged. Favorite moment: donuts from Ruffy for Mike and Raven's 5-year work anniversary and Meech's last week.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Monday 7/13 (MOD: Marcus/Josh/Jesse).** Net sales $2,516.26 (all Marquee) vs a $2,801 target (−10%); 65 guests (18 resys, 47 walk-ins) at a $35.95 check average; comps $29.90 (1.18%, investor discounts). Food $119; no events; garden N/A. Slightly humid but rather lovely. Happy Toast install day — POS training went smoothly since most of the team had used Toast before; a few hiccups flagged to Marcus and an early cash-bank input error (do not use cash in/cash out). Service itself was an easy night; light foot traffic brought some energy but the room never reached capacity. Tight comms kept things flowing as the team settled into the new system. Some fun, cocktail-invested first-time guests joined. Maintenance flagged: rail curtain, floor behind Marquee bar, deck flooring at service entrance. No incidents; no-shows charged.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Monday 7/13 (AM: Sam & Shannon; PM: James & Marcus).** Total net sales $6,577 vs a $4,500 target (+46%); 105 guests (4 morning + 101 evening, OpenTable) at a ~$62.64 average; comps $104.40. Splits: Municipal Bar AM $1,358, PM $4,553, Sun Club $666, Hot Eye $0 (closed); food $2,383; no events. Hot, overcast, never poured too long. Slow morning. Evening nearly caught them off guard: a 12-top split across tables 13/22 at 7:30–8pm for drinks, then another party of 12+ at 8:30–9 for drinks and food; the team put their heads down and kept everyone tended. Sun Club had a great day — steady guests open to close, mostly hotel guests with significant tabs; AC fixed ~3:30pm before rain at 5:45. Kitchen slow until ~8:30, no lows or 86es, but had to waste a bag of mussels (improperly rotated, shipped 6/15). Note: a convention may be in town and Phish plays two shows this week (Tue/Wed) — expect a potentially busy week. No incidents.
